school.name: Rockaway Park High School for Environmental Sustainability
school.overview: Rockaway Park High School is a Future Ready NYC School that prepares all students for college and careers to meet the challenging demands of the 21st century by teaching critical thinking and problem-solving skills. We provide all students with an equitable and culturally responsive education that enables them to grow academically, emotionally, and physically emphasizing that we are stewards of our environment. As a Verizon Innovative Learning school, our students receive free 24/7 tutoring, hotspots, and laptops. To offer a glimpse into college life for students, we offer a variety of Advanced Placement (AP) courses, College Now Classes, and Dual Enrolment Courses. Students are exposed to career opportunities such as: EMT (Emergency Management Training), CPR and Culinary Certifications. Our school also has a Transitional Bilingual Spanish program to support our current and newly arrived ENL students.

programs.name: Rockaway Park High School for Environmental Sustainability (Q36A)
The Green Carpentry Program (Q36G)
programs.description: The carpentry course of study is designed to create an appreciation of the industry and to develop entry-level skills within the carpentry trade, currently on the way to being CTE certified. Students will develop skills that ensure a successful transition from high school to postsecondary institutions.
